verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a documented option to stop prompts and responses from being sent to your configured logging provider. Even then, request metadata such as spend is still tracked. The self-hosted proxy deployment suggests usage data can stay under the operator's control, but nothing shows a switch to disable vendor telemetry. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor telemetry/analytics opt-out flag, a way to disable usage and spend tracking entirely, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no data leaves the deployment.
